what: Fit a Cox proportional hazard model to the Leukemia 6 MP clinical trial dataset
title: Session 7 lab exercise: Cox proportional Hazards
code: library(survival) library(survminer) library(tidyverse) leuk <- readr::read_csv("leuk.csv") %>%   mutate(group = factor(group, levels = c("Placebo", "6 MP"))) ## Rows: 42 Columns: 3 ## ── Column specification ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────── ## Delimiter: "," ## chr (1): group ## dbl (2): time, cens ##  ## ℹ Use `spec()` to retrieve the full column specification for this data. ## ℹ Specify the column types or set `show_col_types = FALSE` to quiet this message.

title: Session 7 lab exercise: Cox proportional Hazards
code: kmfit <- survival::survfit(Surv(time, cens) ~ group, data = leuk) survminer::ggsurvplot(kmfit, risk.table = TRUE, linetype=1:2) ## Ignoring unknown labels: ## • colour : "Strata"

what: Fit exponential and Weibull accelerated failure time (AFT) models
title: Session 7 lab exercise: Cox proportional Hazards
text: Note, don’t compare likelihoods Cox AFT models.
code: coxfit <- coxph(Surv(time, cens) ~ group, data = leuk) expfit <- survreg(Surv(time, cens) ~ group, data = leuk, dist = "exponential") weibullfit <- survreg(Surv(time, cens) ~ group, data = leuk, dist = "weibull") summary(coxfit) summary(expfit) summary(weibullfit) library(stargazer) stargazer(coxfit, expfit, weibullfit, type = "html")

what: Fit a stratified coxph model with a time-dependent covariate using an example from ?coxph
title: Session 7 lab exercise: Cox proportional Hazards
text: Create simple test data set: Fit model stratified sex, time-dependent covariate x:
code: test1 <- data.frame(time=c(4,3,1,1,2,2,3),                status=c(1,1,1,0,1,1,0),                x=c(0,2,1,1,1,0,0),                sex=c(0,0,0,0,1,1,1))  test1 ##   time status x sex ## 1    4      1 0   0 ## 2    3      1 2   0 ## 3    1      1 1   0 ## 4    1      0 1   0 ## 5    2      1 1   1 ## 6    2      1 0   1 ## 7    3      0 0   1 coxph(Surv(time, status) ~ x + strata(sex), test1) ## Call: ## coxph(formula = Surv(time, status) ~ x + strata(sex), data = test1) ##  ##     coef exp(coef) se(coef)     z     p ## x 0.8023    2.2307   0.8224 0.976 0.329 ##  ## Likelihood ratio test=1.09  on 1 df, p=0.2971 ## n= 7, number of events= 5

what: Draw a DAG starting from dagitty.net and re-create it in R
title: Session 7 lab exercise: Cox proportional Hazards
code: library(dagitty) g <- dagitty(' dag { bb="-2,-3,3,3" collider [pos="0,1"] confounder [pos="0,-1"] exposure [exposure,pos="-1,0"] mediator [pos="0,0"] outcome [outcome,pos="1,0"] confounder -> exposure confounder -> outcome confounder -> mediator exposure -> collider exposure -> mediator mediator -> outcome outcome -> collider } ') plot(g)
